questions.question: What famous instruction about trust does Proverbs 3 give?
options: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and do not lean on your own understanding
Trust in the counsel of the older and wiser elders above every other voice
Trust your own judgment in all things, for a truly wise heart is never wrong
Trust in your own great wealth and it will surely keep you safe in the hard times
questions.answer: Trust in the LORD with all your heart and do not lean on your own understanding

questions.question: With what should you honor the LORD, according to Proverbs 3?
options: Your own time given freely in service and in prayer
Your sacrifices offered at the holy altar and nowhere else
Your words of glad praise and your thanksgiving only
Your wealth and the firstfruits of all your produce
questions.answer: Your wealth and the firstfruits of all your produce
